name: lanes
title: Lanes
description: A swimming-school theme in navy on poolside white whose timetable is the pool seen from the gallery: each day a full-width teal lane with its lessons running along it, a white numbered starting-block plate at the deep end and red-and-white float ropes between the lanes.

tokens.--font-display: neo-grotesque face for the site title, headings, day names, class times, block numerals, the menu, buttons and small capital labels
tokens.--font-body: humanist face for body text, intro lines, class names and the footer
tokens.--weight-heavy: weight of headings, the site title, day names, class times, block numerals, buttons, labels and table heads
tokens.--weight-medium: weight of class names, menu links, the first-visit note, disciplines and page links
tokens.--text-s: small text: menu, labels, teacher and level under a class, the Today plate, footer
tokens.--text-l: intro line under a page title, the site title, the Lesson times heading, day names, the first-visit note, quotes and small headings in page text
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in page text and names in the instructor list
tokens.--text-time: the class times in the lanes
tokens.--text-figure: the numeral on each starting-block plate
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings, day names and class times
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the capital labels: site title, menu, day names, buttons
tokens.--color-panel: background of code blocks and the skip link
tokens.--color-text: navy ink: text, headings, links, heavy rules, the current-menu bar, the focus ring and the button ground
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: menu links, intro lines, labels, dates, footer, and the button when hovered
tokens.--color-accent: pool-water teal: the ground of the timetable lanes (and selected text)
tokens.--color-line: thin lines: table rows, code-block edges, the footer rule
tokens.--color-lane-text: day names, class times and class names in the water
tokens.--color-lane-muted: teacher and level under a class, and the no-lessons line, in the water
tokens.--color-float-red: the red floats of the lane ropes
tokens.--color-float-white: the white floats of the lane ropes
tokens.--color-plate: the starting-block plates and the Today plate
tokens.--color-figure: the bare numeral on each starting-block plate and the Today word
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--page-width: maximum page width (masthead, pool, instructor grid)
tokens.--space-s: small gap: between a heading and its line, inside labels
tokens.--space-m: base step: page gutter, padding inside a lane, gaps between classes
tokens.--space-l: gap between sections and between instructor cards
tokens.--space-xl: gap above the footer and around the timetable
tokens.--block: side of the square starting-block plate at the end of each lane
tokens.--rope: thickness of the float ropes between lanes
tokens.--float: length of one float on a rope
tokens.--rule: width of heavy rules: above each instructor, under table heads, beside quotes, the current-menu bar and the focus ring
tokens.--tap: minimum touch height of buttons, menu and page links
tokens.--photo-ratio: instructor photo shape as width divided by height (0.8 is a 4:5 portrait)
